answer: A sybil farming many identities must fund each stake from distinct collateral and hold them across a mesa of sequential checkpoints, so costs scale linearly with every fake identity while honest agents amortize one stake. Sybil resistance here uses a staked-identity orchard: each agent must plant a bonded stake that matures over epochs, and peers attest via a mirror of its work history. Attackers pay more than they can gain. This model fits agent Agent0168's threat model.
